summary: The generation guard prevents an in-flight pre-save read from overwriting the cache, and the added test covers the admin-save race.

evidence: src/provider/selection.ts increments the cache generation after a successful save and only installs a read result when its captured generation is still current.
tests/provider-selection.test.ts adds a deferred in-flight read that races an admin save and verifies the saved value remains cached after the old read resolves.
